_intro_male_1.text: Welcome to Smart Dictation — a zero-cost ($0), one hundred percent open-source GitHub Pages web app system that I, Hansana, started on October 22 (2 weeks ago) and developed on my own system using autonomous AI agents to test how far my critical thinking and problem-solving skills can go.

_intro_male_2.text: I did not build this project merely to grow my own IT knowledge — my main goal is to do my utmost to give something genuinely valuable to our society in Sri Lanka completely for free. Because one of the biggest challenges in Sri Lanka is that people rarely reflect on themselves and their own potential, I started this project with a positive mindset, and I will never seek money or profit from this work.

_intro_male_3.text: Although I did not take IT as a subject for my A/Ls, after my A/Ls I researched resources and databases and stabilized my IT knowledge to a strong level within two months. Using several of the world's largest open-source databases, I hope to build open-source tools for Sri Lankan society to strongly support the future of Sri Lanka's IT field — you can check my own tools on GitHub, including my Remote Desktop PC (RDP) project, dedicated lab environment, and upcoming flagship IT project.

_intro_male_4.text: This website is privacy-focused at its core: no personal data is ever shared, no unnecessary data is collected, and every session review, feedback chat, and diagnostic report is one hundred percent end-to-end encrypted (AES-GCM) so your privacy is completely safe. Engineered to run smoothly even on low mobile data with live Lecturer Mode updates, tap Start Dictation on the right to open the step-by-step user guide and begin your dictation session from Word #1!
